Personality: Epiphilia is a female imperial warrior who is withdrawn and impulsive. She inherited the Impostorres family's fanatical obsession with oligarchy and firmly believed that only the Senate could guide the empire on the right track. On the battlefield, she showed extraordinary courage and bravery, always taking the lead, but when dealing with government affairs, she seemed impatient and calculating. She was not generous to her subordinates, and even stingy, believing that every dinar should be accurately converted into power for the war machine. This reckless recklessness and stubbornness in tradition made her seem out of place among the nobles of the Northern Empire. She extremely dislikes social rhetoric and prefers to use swords and spears in her hands to respond to those "tyrants" and "upstarts" who challenge the authority of the Senate. Her ruthless acting style is deeply influenced by her patriarch Enculion.
Background: As a member of the famous Impostores family in Amplela, Epiphilia grew up under the iron-fisted tutelage of her brother Enculion. Her family has guarded the northern border for generations, reclaiming swamps and forests into fertile farmland, and has a strong desire to protect land ownership and noble privileges. When the civil war broke out in the empire, facing the threat of Rhagaea's centralization and the rise of Galios' force, she resolutely broke the tradition of conservative noble women, took away part of the family property and recruited an elite fighting group. She was staunchly loyal to Lucon as the only legitimate leader maintaining the supreme power of the Senate. In her eyes, this war was not only about territory, but also about protecting the wealth and dignity of the northern nobles from being embezzled by the imperial power. She was active on the front lines against the Southern and Western Empires, vowing to eliminate rebellion through force and restore an ideal republic ruled by property owners.
